labels.name: story
labels.description: User story, fits into one sprint

milestones.title: Sprint 1
milestones.description: Requirements, KPI catalog, synthetic data and cost foundations.

milestones.title: Sprint 2
milestones.description: Glue job, Athena tables and KPI reference views.

milestones.title: Sprint 3
milestones.description: Start of the QuickSight free trial, dashboards, row-level security and refresh.

milestones.title: Sprint 4
milestones.description: UAT, governance, documentation and teardown. QuickSight is cancelled no later than 2027-01-03; UAT is completed before that date.

issues.title: [Epic 1] Requirements and KPI definition
issues.description: Turn the business needs for monitoring a RAG assistant into testable requirements, a single KPI catalog and a data model. Requirements come before technology: every dashboard value must trace back to a requirement and a KPI definition.

issues.title: [F1.1] Requirements specification
issues.description: Stakeholders, functional and non-functional requirements, scope and acceptance rules.

issues.title: [S1.1.1] Stakeholder needs and functional requirements
issues.story: As a product owner, I want documented stakeholder needs and testable functional requirements, so that dashboards are built against agreed needs.
acceptance: Stakeholder table with a default view per role
FR-01 to FR-06 with MoSCoW priority and acceptance criterion
Acceptance rule with tolerances (requirements, section 3.1)

issues.title: [S1.1.2] Non-functional requirements and scope
issues.story: As a product owner, I want measurable non-functional requirements and a clear scope, so that quality and limits are testable.
acceptance: NFR-01 to NFR-05 with measurable acceptance criteria
Out of scope documented, incl. the reason for excluding availability
Open points tracked in the requirements

issues.title: [F1.2] KPI catalog
issues.description: Single source of truth for all KPI formulas, targets and calculation rules.

issues.title: [S1.2.1] KPI definitions and calculation rules
issues.story: As an analyst, I want exactly one formula per KPI, so that SQL and dashboard show the same numbers.
acceptance: KPI-01 to KPI-07 with formula, data source, grain and owner
Calculation rules: Europe/Zurich time zone, ISO weeks, no averaging of ratios, p95 nearest rank

issues.title: [S1.2.2] KPI targets and evaluation rules
issues.story: As a KPI owner, I want justified targets and fair evaluation rules, so that target breaches are meaningful.
acceptance: Targets for KPI-01 to KPI-06 with rationale
Minimum samples: KPI-02 (200 queries), KPI-04 (30 ratings)
Incomplete edge periods are not evaluated against targets

issues.title: [F1.3] Log data model
issues.description: Data model for query logs and model pricing that makes every KPI calculable.

issues.title: [S1.3.1] Data model for query logs and pricing
issues.story: As a data engineer, I want a log data model mapped to the KPIs, so that every KPI can be calculated.
acceptance: rag_query_log fields mapped to KPI, FR and NFR IDs
Fictional model_pricing table, clearly marked as fictional
Assumptions A-1 to A-4 documented

issues.title: [Epic 2] Data foundation
issues.description: Provide reproducible synthetic query logs and a serverless pipeline (S3, Glue, Athena) that turns them into partitioned Parquet data and KPI reference views.

issues.title: [F2.1] Synthetic sample data
issues.description: Reproducible synthetic logs with built-in incident scenarios and an independent validator.

issues.title: [S2.1.1] Reproducible log generator
issues.story: As a developer, I want reproducible synthetic logs, so that all KPIs can be demonstrated without real data.
acceptance: 90 days (2026-08-01 to 2026-10-29), seed 42, identical output on every run
Three incident scenarios: faulty release, latency spike, knowledge gap
Simulation assumptions documented (requirements, section 5.3)
Only one sample day committed to the repository

issues.title: [S2.1.2] Independent data validator
issues.story: As a data engineer, I want validation separate from generation, so that data errors are caught before upload.
acceptance: Checks for schema, allowed values, unique query_id, dt vs. local date and the timeout rule
KPI results per target grain with target breaches
Target breaches occur only in the built-in scenarios
Exit code 1 if any check fails

issues.title: [F2.2] Raw and processed storage (S3 and Glue)
issues.description: Private project bucket with raw and processed layers and a Glue job that converts JSON Lines to partitioned Parquet.

issues.title: [S2.2.1] Secure project bucket
issues.story: As a platform engineer, I want a private, encrypted bucket with raw and processed prefixes, so that the data is stored securely.
acceptance: All public access blocked, ACLs disabled
Default encryption SSE-S3 with Bucket Key; tag Project set
Idempotent setup script

issues.title: [S2.2.2] Upload validated raw data
issues.story: As a data engineer, I want only validated data to be uploaded, so that the pipeline starts from correct input.
acceptance: Local validation runs before any upload and stops it on failure
90 dt partitions uploaded; byte count matches the local files
The upload never deletes objects

issues.title: [S2.2.3] Least-privilege Glue role
issues.story: As a security-minded engineer, I want a Glue role limited to the project bucket, so that a faulty job cannot touch other data.
acceptance: Only the Glue service can assume the role
Read access to raw/ and scripts/, write access to processed/ only
Trade-off for s3:ListBucket documented in the setup script
Updated policy template committed

issues.title: [S2.2.4] Glue job: JSON to partitioned Parquet
issues.story: As a data engineer, I want the raw JSON converted to Parquet partitioned by dt, so that Athena scans as little data as possible.
acceptance: Explicit schema; the job fails if required fields are null
Parquet with Snappy compression, one partition per dt; each run overwrites the output, no duplicates
2 workers, 10-minute timeout, no retries
90 partitions and 27,548 rows written

issues.title: [F2.3] Query layer (Athena)
issues.description: Athena workgroup, table definitions and one reference view per KPI.

issues.title: [S2.3.1] Athena workgroup and table definitions
issues.story: As an analyst, I want queryable tables, so that KPIs can be calculated in SQL.
acceptance: Workgroup with result location, scan limit and tag Project
DDL for rag_query_log and model_pricing stored in sql/
27,548 rows and unique query_id confirmed in Athena

issues.title: [S2.3.2] KPI reference views
issues.story: As a KPI owner, I want one Athena view per KPI, so that dashboard values can be verified.
acceptance: Views for KPI-01 to KPI-07 exactly as defined in the KPI catalog
Exact p95 using nearest rank (no approx_percentile)
Flags for minimum sample size and incomplete edge periods
Results match the local validator within the tolerances of section 3.1

issues.title: [Epic 3] Dashboards
issues.description: Build QuickSight dashboards for management, operations and AI engineering on the Athena KPI views, with row-level security and scheduled refresh. QuickSight is used only within its 30-day free trial and cancelled no later than 2027-01-03.

issues.title: [F3.1] QuickSight setup within the free trial
issues.description: QuickSight subscription in the free trial, Athena data source and dataset.

issues.title: [S3.1.1] QuickSight trial and Athena dataset
issues.story: As the project owner, I want QuickSight only within the 30-day free trial, so that the cost stays within NFR-03.
acceptance: Region eu-central-1; no Pro users, no topics, no Q&A
Cancellation scheduled as a calendar reminder, no later than 2027-01-03
Athena data source and SPICE dataset based on the KPI views

issues.title: [F3.2] KPI dashboards
issues.description: Dashboard sheets for management, operations and AI engineering.

issues.title: [S3.2.1] Management overview
issues.story: As management, I want all KPIs per week and month with their target status, so that I see the overall status at a glance.
acceptance: All KPIs for a selected period with time grain switch (FR-01, FR-02)
Values outside the target are highlighted (FR-05)
Cost per query and query volume included (KPI-06, KPI-07)
Values match the Athena reference views within tolerance

issues.title: [S3.2.2] Operations view
issues.story: As operations, I want daily latency and error rates, so that I can detect incidents quickly.
acceptance: Daily trends for KPI-01 and KPI-02 (FR-04)
Breakdown of failed queries by status and error_type (FR-06)
Latency spike and faulty release scenarios are visible

issues.title: [S3.2.3] AI engineering view
issues.story: As AI engineering, I want quality signals per model and version, so that I can compare releases.
acceptance: KPI-03, KPI-04 and KPI-05 per week
Filters for model_id and app_version (FR-03)
Knowledge gap scenario in ISO week 2026-W42 is visible

issues.title: [F3.3] Access control and refresh
issues.description: Row-level security by team and a scheduled dataset refresh.

issues.title: [S3.3.1] Row-level security by user group
issues.story: As a team lead, I want to see only my team's data, so that access follows the need-to-know principle.
acceptance: Row-level security on user_group: Team A, Team B, Management sees all (NFR-02)
Tested with 2-3 reader users, one per role
Team A values match the Athena reference filtered on team_a

issues.title: [S3.3.2] Scheduled dataset refresh
issues.story: As a dashboard user, I want the data refreshed daily, so that I work with current numbers.
acceptance: Daily refresh scheduled before 08:00 Europe/Zurich (NFR-01)
Refresh history shows a successful run
Note documented that the demo data is static

issues.title: [Epic 4] Governance and quality
issues.description: Make the solution verifiable and trustworthy: acceptance testing against the requirements, governance notes, an automated credential check and documentation of what is actually implemented.

issues.title: [F4.1] Acceptance testing
issues.description: User acceptance tests derived from the functional and non-functional requirements.

issues.title: [S4.1.1] UAT test cases and protocol
issues.story: As a product owner, I want UAT test cases derived from the requirements, so that acceptance is traceable.
acceptance: One test case per FR and NFR
Tolerance rules from section 3.1 applied
Protocol with pass/fail result and evidence per test case
UAT completed before 2027-01-03, while QuickSight is still in the trial

issues.title: [F4.2] Data governance
issues.description: Ownership, classification, access model and protection against publishing credentials.

issues.title: [S4.2.1] Governance notes
issues.story: As a reviewer, I want documented ownership, classification and access rules, so that data handling is transparent.
acceptance: Data classification (synthetic only) and KPI owners documented
Access model including row-level security described
Retention and deletion rules documented

issues.title: [S4.2.2] Automated credential check before commit
issues.story: As the author of a public repository, I want an automatic credential check, so that no secrets are published.
acceptance: Script or pre-commit hook detects access keys, account IDs and private keys (NFR-05)
A finding blocks the commit
Usage documented in the README

issues.title: [F4.3] Documentation
issues.description: Architecture documentation and README that describe only what is implemented.

issues.title: [S4.3.1] Architecture documentation and README
issues.story: As a reader of the portfolio, I want an architecture overview of what is implemented, so that I understand the solution quickly.
acceptance: Mermaid diagram of the implemented data flow only
README roadmap honest and up to date

issues.title: [Epic 5] Cost and operations
issues.description: Keep the project within its cost limit (NFR-03): verified pricing, a tag-filtered budget, cost reporting and a complete teardown after testing.

issues.title: [F5.1] Cost controls
issues.description: Pricing basis, project budget with alerts, cost reporting and tag coverage.

issues.title: [S5.1.1] AWS pricing check
issues.story: As the project owner, I want verified prices with sources, so that cost decisions are based on facts.
acceptance: Research note with retrieval date and official sources
Cost estimate and decisions (QuickSight trial only, 2 Glue workers)
Linked from NFR-03

issues.title: [S5.1.2] Tag-filtered project budget
issues.story: As the project owner, I want alerts on this project's cost only, so that other workloads in the account do not trigger false alarms.
acceptance: Cost allocation tag Project activated
Monthly budget of 50 USD filtered on the project tag
E-mail alerts at 20 USD and 40 USD actual and 100 % forecasted (NFR-03)

issues.title: [S5.1.3] Read-only cost report and inventory
issues.story: As the project owner, I want repeatable cost and resource reports, so that unexpected cost is found quickly.
acceptance: Cost Explorer report by service, usage type and day
Read-only resource inventory script for the used regions

issues.title: [S5.1.4] Tag coverage check
issues.story: As the project owner, I want every project resource tagged, so that the budget covers all project cost.
acceptance: Bucket, IAM role, Glue job and Athena workgroup carry the tag Project
Costs that cannot be tagged (QuickSight, tax) are listed in NFR-03
Read-only check script reports untagged project resources

issues.title: [F5.2] Teardown
issues.description: Remove all project resources after testing so that no running cost remains.

issues.title: [S5.2.1] Teardown script and checklist
issues.story: As the project owner, I want to remove all project resources after testing, so that no running cost remains.
acceptance: Lists all project resources by tag; dry run by default
Deletes only after explicit confirmation
QuickSight cancelled no later than 2027-01-03
Decision documented whether the budget is kept or removed
